2.0.0: Resolved the issues caused by the new LinkedIn API changes.
2.1.0: Updated to new LinkedIn API version and quota.
2.2.0: Updated to new LinkedIn API version.
2.3.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the LinkedIn API.
2.4.0: Updated CreatePost and MakeApiCall to LinkedIn API version 202608 (version 202506 was sunset on June 15, 2026).
CreatePost: validates the required text and the URL and title of a shared link before calling LinkedIn.
Fixed the application-wide shares quota: CreatePost failed with "Error while calling quota server: Invalid time value", and the daily window now resets at the next 08:00 UTC.
2.4.1: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
